meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地 AI 模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用本地模型。
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to call local models from a container via OpenAI-compatible API.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以调用本地 Atomic Chat 应用中的 AI 模型，包括列出可用模型和让模型生成回复。Claude 仍负责协调，但可将任务交给本地模型处理。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求使用 Atomic Chat（例如“使用 atomic chat 回答...”）或让 Claude 调用本地模型时触发。

say.text: 使用 atomic chat 列出可用模型
用 atomic chat 回答：法国的首都是什么？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can call local AI models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app, including listing available models and generating responses. Claude remains the orchestrator but can offload work to local models.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user explicitly asks to use Atomic Chat (e.g., "use atomic chat to answer...") or requests Claude to leverage local models.

say_en.text: List available models using atomic chat
say_en.note: Claude will call the atomic_chat_list_models tool

say_en.text: Use atomic chat to answer: what is the capital of France?
say_en.note: Claude will list models then call atomic_chat_generate to answer
